name: Zack Miller
description: College student in Michigan who bought a defective laptop on eBay and seller refused refund.
quirks: Answers with 1 to 3 words at a time ('michigan', 'laptop broken', 'refund')
Requires patient probing to get basic facts

hidden_case.goal: Recover $850 for defective laptop from seller
facts: Purchased refurbished MacBook for $850 on eBay
Arrived with cracked screen and motherboard failure
Seller listed item as 'Like New, No Returns'
eBay buyer protection claim was denied due to missed window
